issue.title: Standby ToR Link Down Test Cases

failure.body:
Test all packet flow scenarios after link between the standby ToR and fanout goes down

Depends on #2758, #2759, #2756

resolution.title: [dualtor]: Add link down test cases
resolution.description:
Signed-off-by: Lawrence Lee <<EMAIL>>

### Description of PR

Summary:
Closes #2763
Closes #2764

### Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [x] Test case(new/improvement)

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
Test link down scenarios for dual ToR

#### How did you do it?

For each traffic scenario (upstream, downstream to active, downstream to standby):
- Take down the active ToR fanout link to server
- Take down the standby ToR fanout link to server
